name: web/fastapi-service
title: FastAPI service
summary: FastAPI service with typed models, a health route and tests.
when: Use when the project needs a typed JSON API with automatic request validation and OpenAPI docs.

name.about: The service name, used as the FastAPI title and in the health response.

resource.about: The collection name, used for the SQLite table and the route paths (a valid identifier, plural).

next: Write the files, install requirements.txt in a virtual environment, run pytest with pytest and httpx present, then replace the sample fields and resource name with the project's own data.
